name: Parallel Heels
description: Heels on the footbar, legs parallel. Press the carriage out and return with control.

name: Parallel Toes
description: Balls of the feet on the footbar, legs parallel. Press out and return.

name: V-Position Toes
description: Heels together, toes apart on the footbar. Press out and return.

name: Open V-Position Toes
description: Feet wide on the footbar in turnout. Press out and return.

name: Single Leg Heel
description: One heel on the footbar, the other leg in tabletop. Press out and return, keeping the pelvis level.

name: Bottom Lift Bridge
description: Feet on the footbar, roll up into a bridge, then roll down through the spine.

name: Bottom Lift with Extension
description: Feet on the footbar, lift the hips into a bridge, press the carriage out and bring it back in, then lower the hips.

name: Side-Lying Footwork
description: Lying on the side with the top foot on the footbar. Press out and return.

name: The Lying Calves
description: Lying on the back with the toes on the footbar and legs straight. Bend one knee at a time, stretching the calf of the straight leg. Alternate legs.

name: Shoulder Extension
description: Holding the straps, arms to the ceiling. Press the arms down to the hips and return.

name: Shoulder Adduction
description: Holding the straps, arms open to the sides. Bring them down to the hips and return.

name: Triceps
description: Elbows bent by the sides. Extend the forearms down to the hips and bend back.

name: Coordination
description: Curl up, extend arms and legs, open and close the legs, bend the knees, then lower the arms.

name: Arm Circle Up
description: Start with arms to the ceiling and legs in tabletop. Press the arms down as the head and chest curl up and the legs extend. Open the arms to the sides and circle them back up to the ceiling, then lower the head and bend the knees back to tabletop.

name: Hundred
description: Curl up, legs extended, pump the arms breathing in for 5 and out for 5.

name: Overhead
description: Roll the legs over the head, then roll down with control.

name: Bend and Stretch
description: Feet in straps, legs in tabletop. Extend both legs out to 45 degrees and bend back to tabletop.

name: Lower and Lift
description: Feet in straps, legs straight. Lower the legs and lift them back up, keeping the pelvis stable.

name: Hip Circle
description: Feet in straps, legs straight. Circle the legs while keeping the pelvis stable. Reverse.

name: Frog
description: Feet in straps, heels together, knees apart. Extend the legs out and bend back in.

name: Peter Pan
description: Feet in straps, legs straight at 45 degrees in V-position. Open the legs: one knee bends toward the chest with the foot flexed while the other leg opens out to the side. Close back to straight legs at 45 degrees and switch sides.

name: Opening
description: Feet in straps, legs straight. Open the legs to the sides and close.

name: Long Spine Stretch
description: Feet in straps, lift the legs overhead, roll down through the spine.

name: Short Spine Stretch
description: Feet in straps, roll the legs overhead, bend the knees and roll down through the spine.

name: Abdominals with Legs in Straps
description: Lying on the back, reversed, facing the headrest. Long straps around the knees, legs straight to the ceiling, hands cradling the back of the head, head down. Curl up into an abdominal crunch while bending the knees to tabletop so the elbows and knees reach toward each other, then return to the starting position.

name: Oblique Abdominals
description: Same setup as Abdominals with Legs in Straps: lying on the back, reversed, facing the headrest, long straps around the knees, legs straight to the ceiling, hands behind the head. Curl up into a twist, bringing one elbow toward the opposite knee as the knees bend to tabletop, then return. Alternate sides.

name: Flat Back
description: Seated on the short box, feet under the strap. Hinge back with a flat back and return.

name: Round Back
description: Seated on the short box. Roll back in a C-curve and return.

name: Tilt
description: Arms overhead, bend to the side and return, keeping the hips square.

name: Twist
description: Rotate the upper body to one side and return. Alternate sides.

name: Side Sit-Up
description: Sitting sideways on the box, lower the body sideways and lift back up.

name: Climb a Tree
description: One leg up, walk the hands up the leg, roll back and climb back up.

name: Pulling Straps
description: Prone on the long box. Pull the straps back to the hips while lifting the chest.

name: Pulling Straps - Triceps
description: Lying prone on the long box facing the headrest, holding the short straps with straight arms in line with the body. Bend the elbows and extend them back to straight.

name: T-Pull
description: Prone on the long box. Open the arms out to the sides into a T while lifting the chest.

name: One Leg Pull
description: On all fours on the long box facing the headrest, long strap around the arch of one foot. Extend the leg back and bend it back in.

name: Teaser
description: Lying on the back on the long box facing the footbar, holding the short straps with straight arms out to the sides, legs in tabletop. In one movement, lift the head and chest, extend the legs and peel the back off the box until balancing on the tailbone in a V-shape, while the arms circle up through the sides until parallel to the legs. Roll back down with control to the starting position.

name: Breaststroke
description: Prone on the long box. Push the carriage away with the hands, open the arms and lift the chest.

name: Front Split
description: Front foot on the platform, back foot on the carriage. Slide into a split and return.

name: Back Split
description: Standing with one foot on the carriage and the toes of the other foot on the footbar. Open the carriage by straightening the leg on the bar, then try to straighten the front leg as well, moving toward a split. Carefully close the carriage back to the starting position.

name: Side Split
description: One foot on the platform, one on the carriage. Open the legs to the side and close.

name: Pick a Flower
description: One foot on the platform, the other on the carriage, arms straight down. Open the carriage with straight legs as the arms rise out to the sides. Hinge forward with a flat back to a tabletop position and lower the arms toward the floor as if picking something up. Keeping the carriage still, roll up vertebra by vertebra until the arms are overhead. Open the arms to shoulder height, lower them to the sides of the body and close the carriage.

name: Split Squat
description: One foot on the platform, the other on the carriage, arms straight down. Open the carriage as the arms rise out to the sides, then close the carriage as the arms lower back down.

name: Skating
description: One foot on the platform, the other on the carriage. Lower into a squat, then straighten the leg on the carriage to open it and bend it to close the carriage, staying low in the squat on the standing leg.

name: Chest Extension
description: Kneeling facing the straps. Pull the arms back past the hips and return.

name: Rhomboids
description: Sitting on the carriage facing the headrest, legs straight with the feet against the headrest, long straps around the elbows. Elbows bent at 90 degrees at shoulder height in front of the face. Open the arms out to the sides, keeping the 90-degree bend and the elbow height, then close back in front of the face.

name: Biceps
description: Arms out in front holding the straps. Bend the elbows toward the shoulders and extend.

name: Rowing Back
description: Sitting on the carriage facing the headrest, legs straight with the feet against the headrest. Holding the short straps with the elbows bent and the palms facing the face. Roll back with a rounded spine and extend the arms up and over the head. Keeping the arms straight, use the abdominals to roll all the way back up to the starting position.

name: Rowing Front
description: Sitting cross-legged on the carriage facing the footbar, holding the short straps with straight arms by the sides of the body. Lift the arms forward up to shoulder height and lower them back down.

name: Rowing Front - Biceps
description: Sitting cross-legged on the carriage facing the footbar, holding the short straps with the elbows bent and close to the waist. Straighten the arms forward to shoulder height, then bend them and bring the elbows back to the waist.

name: Hug a Tree
description: Arms open to the sides. Bring them together in front as if hugging a tree.

name: Salute
description: Hands by the forehead. Extend the arms up and forward on a diagonal and bend back.

name: Triceps - Kneeling
description: Kneeling and sitting back on the heels, back straight with a slight forward lean. Holding the short straps behind the head with the elbows bent and close to the head. Straighten the arms and bend them back.

name: Shave the Head
description: Hands behind the head. Extend the arms up on a diagonal and bend back.

name: Arm Circle Up
description: Sitting cross-legged on the carriage facing the footbar, holding the short straps with straight arms by the sides of the body. Lift the arms forward past shoulder height all the way up to the ceiling, open them out to the sides and lower them back down.

name: Internal Rotation
description: Sitting cross-legged or kneeling on the carriage, side to the straps, holding a short strap in the hand closer to the shoulder rest. Elbow bent and pressed against the waist, kept stable. Rotate the forearm in toward the body and open it back out, without moving the elbow.

name: External Rotation
description: Sitting cross-legged or kneeling on the carriage, side to the straps, holding a short strap in the hand farther from the shoulder rest. Elbow bent and pressed against the waist, forearm closed across the stomach. Rotate the forearm open away from the body and close it back, without moving the elbow.

name: Adduction
description: Sitting cross-legged or kneeling on the carriage, side to the straps, holding a short strap in the hand farther from the shoulder rest, elbow bent. Pull the elbow out to the side and bring it back.

name: Abduction
description: Sitting cross-legged or kneeling on the carriage, side to the straps, holding a short strap in the hand closer to the shoulder rest. Elbow bent, forearm close to the waist, palm facing the ceiling. Pull the strap in a cradling motion, as if cradling a baby, and return.

name: Side Twist
description: Sitting cross-legged or kneeling on the carriage, side to the straps, holding a short strap in the hand farther from the shoulder rest, elbow bent at shoulder height. Push the elbow outward and straighten the arm out to the side and up, like drawing a sword, then return to the starting position.

name: Side Twist with Rotation
description: Sitting cross-legged or kneeling on the carriage, side to the straps. The hand closer to the shoulder rest holds a short strap, hands clasped together in front of the chest, elbows bent, hands held away from the body. Rotate the torso toward the footbar, keeping the hands clasped, and return.

name: Mermaid
description: Seated sideways, hand on the footbar. Push the carriage out into a side bend and return.

name: Standing Lunge
description: Front foot on the platform, slide the back leg out into a lunge and return.

name: Kneeling Lunge
description: Back knee on the carriage, front foot on the platform. Slide back to stretch the hip flexor.

name: Down Stretch
description: Kneeling with hands on the footbar, chest lifted. Push the carriage back and pull in.

name: Up Stretch
description: From a pike, lower into a plank and push back to the pike.

name: Elephant
description: Hands on the footbar, body in a pike. Move the carriage out and in.
